shades.name: Moss Garden
shades.finish_note: MARBLED here means RESTRAINED OLIVE-ON-OLIVE VEIN STRUCTURE — a darker olive vein through an olive base. NOT antique-gold, and not gold veining of any kind. A renderer that reads the family without this note will look for a hue the builder never computes.
shades.finish_note_superseded_1_2: MARBLED here means restrained antique-gold and olive marbling, NOT bright gold veining. A renderer that reads the family without this note will produce the thing the owner rejected.

note_correction_2026_08_13.struck: 'restrained antique-gold and olive marbling' — the antique-gold half is withdrawn
note_correction_2026_08_13.why_in_terms_of_the_builder_not_taste: MARBLED's components are PER-CHANNEL MULTIPLICATIVE of the base (darker = rgb x [0.45, 0.55, 0.70]), and marbling.components is 2, so the mix is [base, darker] and the additive offsets that could shift hue never enter. Chroma (R-B)/(R+G+B) is scale-invariant under a per-channel multiplication, so the two components are chroma-separated by a FIXED amount that neither grows nor collapses with lightness: MEASURED 0.119085 at Moss Garden's authored depth and 0.119085 at 6.35x lighter. Gold requires a hue the derivation never computes from an olive base. The note was asking for something the builder cannot produce, at any lightness.
note_correction_2026_08_13.what_the_pan_DOES_deliver: chroma spread 0.015150 against a POWDER_MATTE control at the same colour and seed of 0.001547 — 9.8x. Confirmed at 9de3457 as unaffected by the region and retired-scalar defects that invalidated the luminance readings: MARBLED is albedo-derived, chroma is the right axis for it, and PLANAR is a legitimate region to read chroma on.
note_correction_2026_08_13.scope: a NOTE correction. NOT a family change, NOT a colour change, and not a change to any other shade.
note_correction_2026_08_13.lobe_axis_standing_stated_in_the_same_br: on the lobe axes and under the programme's own eligibility and R5 rules, MARBLED clears ONE countable axis against POWDER_MATTE at this colour (SHEEN 0.286) where PASS_LAW requires two, so it does not certify as a distinguishable family on those axes. Its chroma reading is a different instrument and is not a substitute for that. Recorded here so the 9.8x figure is never read as a family verdict.

shades.name: Midnight Bloom
shades.finish_note: POWDER_METALLIC, chosen by the owner over SHIMMER because #4A2E3B is dark enough that a soft pearl load disappears into its own base. Shares its family with Copper Leaf (pan 7); they sit at opposite ends of the depth run. The duplication is recorded, not hidden.

COLOUR_SPACE_FINDING.question: the hexes are sRGB. Is PowderShade.rgb consumed as sRGB or as scene-linear?
what_settles_it: apps/pipeline/services/blender_scripts/powder_materials.py:168 — _base() assigns that triple straight to the Principled BSDF socket: b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2], 1.0). A Blender node socket colour default_value is scene-linear.
apps/pipeline/services/blender_scripts/powder_materials.py:492 and the seven _mottle_colour call sites — same triple, same socket, no transform on any path

apps/pipeline/services/blender_scripts/material_characterization.py:49-51 — view_transform = 'Standard', view_settings.gamma = 1.0. That is a DISPLAY-side encode of a scene-linear render; it is not an input transfer and does not convert display_rgb.
the frame records the rig writes carry measured_in = SCENE_LINEAR and source = 'Blender float Render Result before display conversion', confirming the pipeline is scene-linear internally

no_conversion_exists_extent_A564.predicate: any occurrence of srgb, sRGB, to_linear, linear_to, gamma, 2.4, 1.055 or 0.0031308
no_conversion_exists_extent_A564.result: the only hits are view_settings.gamma = 1.0 in eight render scripts, which is display-side, and a 2.4 that is a macrotexture scale_mm. NO sRGB-to-linear transfer exists anywhere on the path from PowderShade.rgb to Base Color.

DIRECTION_CORRECTED_2026_08_13.withdrawn: the 1.0 revision of this record said these render 'DARKER and less saturated than the chosen colour'. That was INVERTED and is withdrawn.
DIRECTION_CORRECTED_2026_08_13.true_direction: srgb_to_linear is strictly BELOW the identity on the open interval (0,1), so an sRGB value handed to a linear socket sets an albedo that is too HIGH and every pan arrives LIGHTER and less saturated. Never darker.
DIRECTION_CORRECTED_2026_08_13.proven_not_asserted: TransferDirectionTests in test_powder_engine.py — 20001 samples across (0,1) in each direction, endpoints fixed as equalities, segment knee pinned at 0.04045 / 0.0031308
DIRECTION_CORRECTED_2026_08_13.error_is_NOT_uniform: negligible at the light end, severe at the deep end: Petal Veil's lightest channel gains 0.0282, Midnight Bloom's green gains 0.2814 — an order of magnitude apart
DIRECTION_CORRECTED_2026_08_13.what_actually_degrades: the palette's own STRUCTURE, not merely its brightness. The depth run Damascena -> Blush Hour -> Old Rose -> Thorn retains only 68.3% of its intended spread (0.4288 -> 0.2930) because its pale members arrive nearly correct while its deep members do not. A uniform shift could be dialled out downstream; a compressed depth run cannot, and the run is what the palette was designed around.

worked_example_midnight_bloom.reads_as: a pale dusty mauve where a deep plum was chosen
worked_example_midnight_bloom.owner_figure_differed: the owner's brief gave #93768A; recomputed here the blue channel is 0x84, not 0x8A. The owner's own triple 0.518 -> round(0.518*255) = 132 = 0x84 agrees with this, so the brief's hex was internally inconsistent with the brief's own triple. Per the brief's instruction the computed value stands.
worked_example_midnight_bloom.bound_on_this_figure: arrival is the ALBEDO ROUND-TRIP under neutral unit illumination, not a render prediction — lighting, BSDF and roughness all intervene in a real frame. The DIRECTION is unconditional because the albedo is unconditionally too high; the MAGNITUDE is the flat-lit figure.

COLOUR_SPACE_FINDING.what_this_record_does: keeps the sRGB hex as the stored authority per Step 4(b), and carries rgb_linear beside it as a DERIVED field with the transfer named. A renderer targeting the scene-linear socket must read rgb_linear; a renderer targeting an sRGB-referred surface must read rgb.
COLOUR_SPACE_FINDING.what_this_record_does_NOT_do: SUPERSEDED AT 1.2. When this record was written the engine did not change the shader: PowderShade.rgb held the sRGB triple and realize() emitted it as display_rgb untransformed. Since beb1fe5 realize() applies the transfer at the engine boundary — the frozen builder is still untouched and every material identity is still unmoved, because the space rides on the already-digested authority.

WHY_DEFERRED_JUSTIFICATION_CORRECTED_202.withdrawn: the 1.0 revision said fixing the shader 'would move every material_identity in the programme'. That was WRONG. material_identity() at palette_powder_engine.py:510-516 digests schema, version, family, seed, shade.to_dict() and params; powder_materials.py is not among its inputs, so editing the builder moves NO material identity.
WHY_DEFERRED_JUSTIFICATION_CORRECTED_202.the_real_constraint: powder_materials.py is the FROZEN INSTRUMENT. Every M6 measurement was taken through it and its repair is M6-CONTRACT-INTEGRITY-REPAIR's named jurisdiction, recorded at independence_amendment_phase4.json against builder:specular_ior_level and the other builder drivers: 'varying it means editing the frozen instrument, which is M6-CONTRACT-INTEGRITY-REPAIR's jurisdiction and may not start inside this node.'
WHY_DEFERRED_JUSTIFICATION_CORRECTED_202.the_refusal_stands: only its justification changes. The fix is still not taken here.
